rule_name: Potential Structuring — Multiple Sub-Threshold Cash Deposits
rule_description: Flags 3+ cash deposits each below $10,000 threshold within a 10-day rolling window totalling over $20,000.
trigger_summary: 9 cash deposits between $7,800 and $9,900 totalling $83,800 over 9 days across multiple branch locations and ATMs.
ground_truth_rationale: High frequency of sub-threshold cash deposits ($83,800 total) far exceeds retail clerk declared salary ($4,200/mo) with no economic rationale provided. Classic structuring pattern under BSA/AML.

rule_name: Rapid Movement of Funds — Pass-Through / Layering
rule_description: Flags incoming wire followed within 24 hours by outgoing wire for >90% of received value, with little or no account balance retention.
trigger_summary: Customer received $145,000 domestic wire from Nexus Trading Partners and executed $142,000 international wire to BVI entity on the same day.
ground_truth_rationale: Unemployed student profile with $1,500/mo expected income used as a conduit for $145,000 rapid pass-through to offshore offshore haven (BVI) within hours.

rule_description: Flags transaction volume exceeding 500% of customer's declared monthly income within a 7-day period.
trigger_summary: Two cashier check deposits totalling $102,000 deposited in 4 days vs declared monthly income of $6,000.
ground_truth_rationale: Deposits represent 17x monthly declared income for graphic designer; cashier check remitter details require source of wealth investigation before STR determination.

rule_description: Flags significant wire inflows (> $50,000) on accounts with zero transactional activity in prior 12+ months.
trigger_summary: Dormant savings account received $88,000 international wire from Dubai, followed 24 hours later by $85,000 outflow to cryptocurrency exchange.
ground_truth_rationale: Sudden reactivation of dormant retail account by offshore wire followed by immediate crypto conversion indicates account takeover or money mule activity.

rule_description: Flags outbound transfers returned or reversed by the same counterparty within 72 hours for >95% of initial value.
trigger_summary: Customer wired $62,000 to Vortex Media Ventures, which returned $61,500 within 48 hours referencing cancelled loan.
ground_truth_rationale: Circular transfer with minimal economic purpose; requires analyst outreach to customer for loan agreement or verified cancellation memo.

rule_name: Business Volume Surge vs Rolling Baseline
rule_description: Flags commercial deposits exceeding 300% of rolling 90-day average deposit volume.
trigger_summary: Sharma Artisan Imports received $90,500 in Shopify/Square merchant processor deposits in 4 days.
ground_truth_rationale: Documented seasonal retail importer experiencing known Q4 holiday craft surge via registered merchant card settlement processors; verified supplier customs wire on file.

rule_name: Single Large Cash Deposit Near Threshold
rule_description: Flags single cash deposit between $9,500 and $9,999 within 5 days of payroll.
trigger_summary: Single cash deposit of $9,950 into personal checking account.
ground_truth_rationale: Isolated cash deposit of $9,950 by established software engineer with bill of sale for private used car on file; no subsequent rapid outflows.

rule_description: Flags incoming wires greater than or equal to $250,000 for individual accounts.
trigger_summary: Incoming wire of $450,000 from First American Title & Escrow Co.
ground_truth_rationale: Real estate broker customer receiving verified escrow proceeds with attached HUD-1 settlement sheet and title deed; funds deployed directly into US Treasury Bills.

rule_description: Flags rapid international transfers exceeding $50,000 on accounts with incomplete KYC validation.
trigger_summary: Customer account executed $85,000 incoming wire and $82,000 outgoing wire within 24 hours.
ground_truth_rationale: Insufficient evidence to determine legitimacy: Customer record lacks declared occupation, income, and CDD documentation due to legacy data migration defect. Must obtain KYC before disposition.

rule_description: Flags simultaneous surge across non-standard cash/check deposit channels for professional services accounts.
trigger_summary: Combination of cashier checks and electronic deposits totaling $105,200 in one week.
ground_truth_rationale: Mixed indicators: partial legitimate design invoices present alongside high-value cashier checks without remitter documentation.

rule_description: Flags any single transaction over $25,000 involving an active or former PEP.
trigger_summary: PEP account received $38,000 international wire from Jordanian consultancy followed by $12,000 cash withdrawal.
ground_truth_rationale: Customer is a designated PEP; while advisory retainer is plausibly aligned with expertise, regulatory EDD requires contract validation and purpose verification.

rule_description: Flags any transaction involving a counterparty matching internal or OFAC-equivalent sanctions entities.
trigger_summary: Account received $75,000 international wire from Belka Capital Holdings Ltd, a listed sanctions entity.
ground_truth_rationale: Direct wire inflow from Belka Capital Holdings Ltd, designated on sanctions watchlists for illicit trade financing. Mandatory immediate escalation and asset freeze review.
